_comment: Per-area playbook text. Edit here (or regenerate with the area_summary prompt) - the pipeline reads it.

Identity verification (KYC / ID checks).title: Resilient ID scan and alternative verification paths
Identity verification (KYC / ID checks).positives: Passport-tap ID check described as easy to join; some customers accept KYC as a legal requirement.
Identity verification (KYC / ID checks).negatives: Passport scan loops, repeated KYC demands (even after cancelling), account-stop threats, and forced app verification for NetBank access.
Identity verification (KYC / ID checks).improvement: Make ID/KYC checks more tolerant (alternative documents, retry guidance, non-citizen/non-licence paths); explain why a check failed and avoid forcing a branch visit.
Identity verification (KYC / ID checks).competitor_offer: Competitors mostly face the same friction: ANZ requires branch visits when KYC fails for ANZ Plus-to-main-ANZ links and offers an ANZ Shield app for stronger authentication; Westpac uses in-app selfie/face-recognition and tight address-verification rules (licence/proof-of-age card), which customers say can fail repeatedly. No competitor stands out as clearly easier.
Identity verification (KYC / ID checks).mobile_features: ANZ: Voice ID adds step-up verification for higher-value payments; login recovery with card, PIN and registered mobile. Westpac NZ (indicative): reset PIN/password in-app, manage app devices. NAB: Face ID/fingerprint/passcode login. No competitor guide shows a lighter-touch KYC refresh journey.
Identity verification (KYC / ID checks).mobile_recommendation: Add alternative ID routes and in-app retry guidance when passport/licence scanning fails; offer step-up (voice or device-based) instead of forcing a branch visit.
Identity verification (KYC / ID checks).business_intel: ANZ business customers describe KYC-refresh emails that look like scams, followed by account freezes.

Account opening & sign-up.title: In-app account opening for existing customers
Account opening & sign-up.positives: Easy, quick sign-up praised ('so easy to join', tap-your-passport ID) and direct recommendations to join.
Account opening & sign-up.negatives: Forced data/privacy consent, IDs or addresses not accepted, 24-hour holds on first payments to new payees, and long-term customers feel new customers get priority.
Account opening & sign-up.improvement: Shorten and simplify digital account opening; pre-fill known customer data; give live progress/status and a clear fallback when digital checks fail.
Account opening & sign-up.competitor_offer: NAB customers praise a fully online, step-by-step account opening and quick card turnaround; ANZ Plus users describe an easy digital sign-up/set-up and in-app account aggregation; Westpac customers highlight patient in-branch/in-app guidance when opening accounts. Pain points seen: ANZ re-asks for data it already holds when verifying a profile.
Account opening & sign-up.mobile_features: ANZ: existing customers with an Australian residential address can open a new account inside the app. NAB: personal accounts open online; app registration is Login > Register. Westpac NZ (indicative): register and log in guide, choose your own username, find your Customer ID.
Account opening & sign-up.mobile_recommendation: Offer in-app account opening for existing customers (as ANZ does) with pre-filled profile data, and a visible progress/status tracker so applicants do not restart.
Account opening & sign-up.business_intel: Thin evidence. A NAB customer reports 3+ weeks to open a business account; Macquarie (outside the three) is cited for online SMSF account opening within days.

App registration & device set-up.title: Guided new-phone migration and device management
App registration & device set-up.positives: Few genuine positives; some find installation and registration painless.
App registration & device set-up.negatives: Forced updates that block the app, apps wanting to read other installed apps, repeated reinstalls and re-registration, and lock-out after phone change or damage.
App registration & device set-up.improvement: Streamline app registration and new-device migration (one-step device change, clear error messages, in-app recovery instead of calling support).
App registration & device set-up.strength: Easy app set-up and device switching
App registration & device set-up.competitor_offer: NAB offers NAB Connect/in-app guided sign-up and fast set-up that users call 'easy'; Westpac lets customers register their phone as a security device and fingerprint/biometrics in-app; ANZ Plus/ANZ Shield uses app-based codes in place of SMS. Customers also report registration/reinstall loops at ANZ and device-update lock-outs at NAB.
App registration & device set-up.mobile_features: ANZ: up to 5 devices registered with one 4-digit PIN across all devices; 'Manage Devices' in the app to deregister; lost device can be deregistered via Internet Banking; published OS floor (iOS 15 / Android 8) and app size (~350MB iOS, ~100MB Android). NAB: Register from the app's Login screen; NAB Connect uses a mobile token set up in the app. Westpac NZ (indicative): manage the app devices your details are saved on; guidance for unsupported phones.
App registration & device set-up.mobile_recommendation: Offer a guided new-phone migration and a 'Manage Devices' screen (ANZ pattern: up to 5 devices, one PIN); publish the OS support floor and app size so customers are not caught out by updates.
App registration & device set-up.business_recommendation: BUSINESS: NAB Connect mobile token is set up in the app and an Administrator manages users. Suggest simple token set-up and device management for business admins.
App registration & device set-up.business_intel: NAB Connect sign-up confuses sole traders (which legal name to use); a Westpac SMSF approval is reported as handled offshore; ANZ Plus 'Profile & security' screens error for months and Westpac profile switching fails on reinstall; ANZ asks business customers to re-confirm detailed information.

Product applications (cards, loans, home.title: In-app instalment plans and application tracking
Product applications (cards, loans, home.positives: Loans approved and funded within about 24 hours (e.g. solar/green loan); conditional approval and pre-approval visible in the app.
Product applications (cards, loans, home.negatives: Overseas online payment approval and MFA approval loops fail; HECS and credit checks confuse assessments.
Product applications (cards, loans, home.improvement: Give transparent, faster credit decisions with clear reasons for declines, upfront document checklists and application status tracking.
Product applications (cards, loans, home.competitor_offer: ANZ retention teams are reported to counter with cashback (about $2k) and lower rates when customers lodge a discharge request; ANZ and Westpac customers describe tough credit-card approval criteria, while NAB customers cite fast account-to-card turnaround. Broker-lodged home loans are common across the three.
Product applications (cards, loans, home.mobile_features: ANZ: Instalment Plan applied for in the credit card 'Manage' section (choose amount and instalments, cancel any time); card activation in-app; book a Home Loan/Personal/Business specialist appointment in-app. NAB: home loan and personal loan calculators and appointment booking on web. Westpac NZ (indicative): change loan repayments and fix/refix a home loan in digital banking.
Product applications (cards, loans, home.mobile_recommendation: Add in-app instalment plans and application tracking (ANZ Instalment Plan), plus in-app specialist appointment booking.

Account closure & switching away.title: Clear device deregistration vs account closure flow
Account closure & switching away.positives: Clear 31-day notice with any leftover credit returned by cheque; some retention offers when customers complain.
Account closure & switching away.negatives: Debanking without reasons, closing accounts over privacy/digital ID changes, poor service and high fees driving customers to leave.
Account closure & switching away.improvement: Improve retention journeys and make closure/switching simple and respectful; address the root causes customers cite when leaving (service, fees, access).
Account closure & switching away.strength: Customers feel no need to leave
Account closure & switching away.competitor_offer: Customers who leave ANZ/NAB/Westpac most often move to smaller banks (e.g. Bank Australia) citing hold times and branch/cash policy; ANZ Plus is praised as easy to set up with account aggregation, which attracts switchers.
Account closure & switching away.mobile_features: ANZ: explains deregistering the app does not close accounts and that uninstalling does not deregister devices. Other guides reviewed do not cover closure in the app.
Account closure & switching away.mobile_recommendation: Make 'deregister device' vs 'close account' explicit in the app (ANZ copy) and add a short exit-reason prompt so retention teams can respond.
Account closure & switching away.business_intel: ANZ business customers (one with 33 years) want to leave but find switching painful; process pain around KYC and credit cards drives intent to move.

Statement access & download (PDF / e-sta.title: Custom-period statements with 2+ years in app
Statement access & download (PDF / e-sta.positives: Statements can be downloaded and referenced for direct-debit checks; document reference numbers are on statements.
Statement access & download (PDF / e-sta.negatives: Statements no longer accessible in the app, limited search history (months/2 years), no custom period, and NetBank still needed.
Statement access & download (PDF / e-sta.improvement: Make statements easy to find, download and share in-app (PDF, date ranges, proof-of-balance/letters on demand) and allow screenshots/sharing of transaction details.
Statement access & download (PDF / e-sta.competitor_offer: ANZ app lets customers view balance, pending money and bank statements in-app and provide proof of balance (a gap some report); NAB users ask for easier-to-find statements; Westpac offers tax-relevant transaction downloads in-app. Competitors show no clear advantage here.
Statement access & download (PDF / e-sta.mobile_features: ANZ: statements tab on each account, pick latest statement or by year. NAB: view and download up to two years of statements in the app. Westpac NZ (indicative): check transactions and get statements, stop paper statements, find and share proof of account.
Statement access & download (PDF / e-sta.mobile_recommendation: Show statements per account with custom date ranges and at least two years in-app (NAB); keep screenshot/share of transaction details available.
Statement access & download (PDF / e-sta.business_recommendation: BUSINESS: customers need statements for BAS. Suggest on-demand business statements with custom date ranges and an export for accountants.
Statement access & download (PDF / e-sta.business_intel: ANZ business customers cite 4+ day delays obtaining a statement for BAS after closing an account; NAB statement changes triggered fee surprises.

Transaction history, search & export.title: Restore transaction share, receipts and richer search
Transaction history, search & export.positives: A 15-minute 'screen sharing controls' option allows screenshots as a workaround; transaction details can be shared.
Transaction history, search & export.negatives: Screenshot ban and removal of share-receipt make proof of payment hard; customers want merchant logos and clearer transaction detail.
Transaction history, search & export.improvement: Extend history depth, add richer search/filters (description, amount, date), raise export limits (CSV/OFX) and restore transaction share/receipt features.
Transaction history, search & export.competitor_offer: NAB shows transaction history in-app but users ask for transaction times and a 'send receipt' button (offered by other apps); Westpac/NAB users report filter and ordering issues. ANZ users value full payment history visibility. No competitor clearly leads.
Transaction history, search & export.mobile_features: NAB: tap a purchase for retailer name, phone number and map. ANZ: clearer descriptions via Look Who's Charging, with the original statement description at the bottom of each transaction. Westpac NZ (indicative): check, search and filter transactions. NAB Connect: Payment Register with filter and payment history audit trail.
Transaction history, search & export.mobile_recommendation: Restore share/receipt and screenshot options; add NAB-style tap-to-identify (retailer name, phone, map) and ANZ-style original-description toggle; allow search/filter by description and date.
Transaction history, search & export.business_recommendation: BUSINESS: NAB customers ask for a send/share payment receipt button and transaction times. Suggest shareable receipts with timestamps for bookkeeping.

Statement accuracy, merchant names & des.title: Clean merchant names with original description toggle
Statement accuracy, merchant names & des.positives: Few comments; merchant names are controlled by the bank, which customers see as a safeguard.
Statement accuracy, merchant names & des.negatives: Jumble of numbers instead of merchant logos/simple names; limited feedback volume.
Statement accuracy, merchant names & des.improvement: Show clean, recognisable merchant names and consistent transaction descriptions; ensure balances and statement figures are correct and searchable.
Statement accuracy, merchant names & des.competitor_offer: Very little competitor feedback. ANZ lets customers transfer money without a mandatory description; NAB customers complain that payments take around 3 days to clear and show an incorrect balance in the meantime.
Statement accuracy, merchant names & des.mobile_features: ANZ: cleaner merchant descriptions (Look Who's Charging) with original text one tap away, exclusive to the app. NAB: tap-to-identify purchase shows retailer name, phone and map.
Statement accuracy, merchant names & des.mobile_recommendation: Adopt clean merchant names/logos with a one-tap 'original description' view (ANZ Look Who's Charging pattern) to fix the 'jumble of numbers' complaint.
Statement accuracy, merchant names & des.business_intel: Westpac's Cashflow money tool is reported to show duplicate transactions in the mobile app.

Tax, interest & account letters / summar.title: Shareable proof of account and tax summaries
Tax, interest & account letters / summar.positives: Very little CBA feedback in this area.
Tax, interest & account letters / summar.negatives: Very little CBA feedback in this area.
Tax, interest & account letters / summar.improvement: Provide self-service tax/interest summaries and account confirmation letters in the app without branch or call-centre requests.
Tax, interest & account letters / summar.competitor_offer: Very little competitor feedback on this area. Westpac offers in-app downloads of tax-relevant transactions (e.g. app 12.x updates); NAB requires tax residency evidence on request.
Tax, interest & account letters / summar.mobile_features: Westpac NZ (indicative): find and share proof of account directly from the app. ANZ/NAB guides reviewed do not show tax or interest summaries in the app.
Tax, interest & account letters / summar.mobile_recommendation: Add shareable proof-of-account/balance and tax/interest summaries in-app (Westpac NZ proof-of-account pattern).
Tax, interest & account letters / summar.business_intel: ANZ self-employed lending requires ABN registration, financials, tax returns and NOA.

Fraud, scam & account holds / blocks.title: In-app dispute and transparent fraud holds
Fraud, scam & account holds / blocks.positives: CBA is seen as among the most secure; fraud team contact is easy to find; cards are blocked after repeated wrong attempts; customers are warned about known scams.
Fraud, scam & account holds / blocks.negatives: Disputes auto-closed forcing restart, no alert on a large fraudulent spend, invasive tracking justified as fraud prevention, and holds/blocks without clear reasons.
Fraud, scam & account holds / blocks.improvement: Reduce false-positive blocks (e.g. crypto, Uber, overseas), give clear reasons and ETAs, enable fast self-service unblock/verification, and speed up scam/dispute outcomes and reimbursement.
Fraud, scam & account holds / blocks.competitor_offer: Westpac customers praise dynamic 3-digit CVC that changes daily, OTP step-up on large online payments and proactive fraud detection; NAB customers cite fraud-team interception of fraudulent payments before they leave the account; ANZ customers highlight an effective card disputes team recovering scam losses. All three also draw complaints for blocking crypto-exchange payments (ANZ and Westpac cap crypto at about $10k) and for false-positive locks.
Fraud, scam & account holds / blocks.mobile_features: ANZ: in-app 'Something not right?' dispute on any transaction with progress updates; Falcon fraud monitoring; published explanation of behavioural data collected (touch, keystroke, clipboard) and a promise not to use it for marketing; session-based app stores no banking data on the device. NAB: block/unblock card, tap-to-identify a purchase; online dispute guide. Westpac NZ (indicative): dispute a Mastercard transaction, suspicious-payment guidance, how to know you are in the real app, lost-phone steps.
Fraud, scam & account holds / blocks.mobile_recommendation: Add an in-app dispute entry on each transaction with status updates (ANZ 'Something not right?'); publish a plain-language explanation of behavioural data collection like ANZ; add NAB-style tap-to-identify to reduce disputes.
Fraud, scam & account holds / blocks.business_intel: ANZ is most cited: business accounts frozen after KYC requests (one case took 2 weeks to unfreeze) and complaints that business-account notifications for money in/out stopped; Westpac cites new AML rules flagging a business and a VPN conflict with its fraud controls. No competitor is seen as clearly better at unblocking.

Payment limits.title: View and change payment limits in app, iOS/Android parity
Payment limits.positives: Card settings let customers lock online, international or gambling payments and set withdrawal limits.
Payment limits.negatives: Cardless QR withdrawal limit differs between iOS ($500) and Android ($1,000).
Payment limits.improvement: Let customers view and change daily/transfer/ATM limits instantly in-app (with step-up auth) and explain limit rules clearly.
Payment limits.competitor_offer: ANZ imposes about a $10k monthly limit on crypto/exchange payments and has no in-app way to change ATM limits; NAB customers prefer changing daily limits and travel notices in-app; Westpac users find limit changes slow. Self-service limit management is a differentiator for NAB.
Payment limits.mobile_features: ANZ: limits published in the FAQ (Pay Anyone $1,000 'Today', BPAY $10k new/$15k saved) with Voice ID step-up for higher amounts (up to $25,000/day Pay Anyone, $100,000/day BPAY). NAB Connect: schedule up to 90 days ahead; multi-user authorisation for business payments. NAB: manage contactless, online and overseas payments per card.
Payment limits.mobile_recommendation: Show current limits and change them in-app with step-up auth; keep iOS and Android limits identical (CBA customers report a $500 vs $1,000 cardless withdrawal gap).
Payment limits.business_recommendation: BUSINESS: NAB Connect uses role-based authorisation and an Administrator role; ANZ applies Voice ID for higher limits. Suggest in-app limit changes with administrator approval for business users.

Pending, delayed, failed or missing tran.title: Payment status tracking and failed-payment alerts
Pending, delayed, failed or missing tran.positives: App clearly shows Available vs Balance vs Pending; refunds are eventually processed.
Pending, delayed, failed or missing tran.negatives: Credit-card payments pending where other banks are instant, pending items causing overdrawn balances, cardless cash never completing, and failed auto-payments with penalties.
Pending, delayed, failed or missing tran.improvement: Improve real-time posting and visibility of pending items, explain delays/holds, and provide proactive status updates and fast resolution of failed or missing payments.
Pending, delayed, failed or missing tran.competitor_offer: ANZ and Westpac users complain of long pending periods and holds (e.g. ANZ holding inbound payments around 3 business days, NAB around 3 days to clear); ANZ bankers have a discretionary refund for service failures. No competitor clearly resolves pending visibility better.
Pending, delayed, failed or missing tran.mobile_features: ANZ: future payments show clear statuses (Pending, Deleted, Skipped, Locked, Failed), but customers are not notified when one fails. NAB: payment processing times guide; NAB Connect shows Overnight (next business day) vs Fast payment (Osko, usually under a minute) before submit. NAB Connect: payment history lists each step.
Pending, delayed, failed or missing tran.mobile_recommendation: Add ANZ-style payment statuses for scheduled/pending items plus the alert ANZ lacks: notify customers when a scheduled payment fails; show Osko-vs-overnight expected time before submit (NAB Connect).
Pending, delayed, failed or missing tran.business_recommendation: BUSINESS: NAB Connect payment history lists each step and flags payments needing repair; suggest the same audit trail for business payments.
Pending, delayed, failed or missing tran.business_intel: Westpac self-service/AI-only support is criticised when payments need human intervention.

Payments & transfers (PayID / BPAY / Pay.title: Easier BPAY, scheduled payments and payee confirmation
Payments & transfers (PayID / BPAY / Pay.positives: PayID/Osko/BPAY are available and widely used; payments are mostly smooth.
Payments & transfers (PayID / BPAY / Pay.negatives: BPAY view hidden, 24-hour holds on PayID payments (e.g. crypto exchanges), 'instant' transfers that are not, and payment holds without explanation.
Payments & transfers (PayID / BPAY / Pay.improvement: Keep payments fast and predictable: clearer payee/PayID confirmation, easier scheduled/recurring payments, fewer unexplained declines and better error messages.
Payments & transfers (PayID / BPAY / Pay.competitor_offer: NAB shows payee identity/name before sending a PayID payment and offers NAB-to-NAB transfers; Westpac's upgrade is praised for easy recurring payments; ANZ supports one-off and scheduled transfers. Gap noted: NAB users want to delete PayID when changing numbers.
Payments & transfers (PayID / BPAY / Pay.mobile_features: ANZ: PayID payments often within about 60 seconds; save payees; schedule, edit, delete and skip future payments; 'Ongoing & One-off Payments' screen lists card subscriptions and direct debits. NAB: set up a unique PayID in-app; NAB Connect lets you pick payment method (overnight/fast), pay by BSB, phone, email, business number or organisation ID, warns on a new/unused payee. Westpac NZ (indicative): add/edit payee, cut-off times guide, pause or change a Split.
Payments & transfers (PayID / BPAY / Pay.mobile_recommendation: Make BPAY and scheduled payments easier to find; add edit/skip for scheduled payments and an 'Ongoing & One-off Payments' view (ANZ); show payee identity/payee-type options and a new-payee warning (NAB Connect).
Payments & transfers (PayID / BPAY / Pay.business_recommendation: BUSINESS: NAB Connect mobile supports overnight vs fast payments, scheduling up to 90 days, pay-by BSB/phone/email/business number/organisation ID, a payment register (-7 to +30 days) with filter, and authorise/delete payments from the app. Suggest matching multi-user authorisation and a payment register in the CBA business app.
Payments & transfers (PayID / BPAY / Pay.business_intel: NAB Bookkeeper gets positive early feedback for business bookkeeping; Westpac business payments reported backed up and a PayID payment blocked; a customer moved NAB business banking to Bendigo citing service.

Card payments, tap-to-pay & digital wall.title: Card controls and wallet health-check for tap & pay
Card payments, tap-to-pay & digital wall.positives: PayWave/tap and card controls are valued as secure; many customers use cards without issue.
Card payments, tap-to-pay & digital wall.negatives: Tap & pay frequently broken, unable to add/remove cards, forced mode switching, and repeated card issues leaving customers without access.
Card payments, tap-to-pay & digital wall.improvement: Improve card/wallet reliability (Apple/Google Pay provisioning, declines), expand card controls (lock, limits, virtual/dynamic CVC) and give clear decline reasons.
Card payments, tap-to-pay & digital wall.competitor_offer: Westpac offers a Worldwide Wallet for travel and dynamic CVC security; NAB users value safe/secure everyday card and wallet payments. Wallet and card-control feature parity is broadly similar across the big banks.
Card payments, tap-to-pay & digital wall.mobile_features: NAB: block/unblock/reorder cards, reset PIN, view digital cards, manage contactless/online/overseas payments; Apple Pay, Google Pay and Samsung Pay set-up guides. ANZ: activate cards (most personal cards) and secondary cards in-app, temporary block that keeps direct debits running, Instalment Plan. Westpac NZ (indicative): manage and use credit and debit cards in digital banking, block/cancel/replace.
Card payments, tap-to-pay & digital wall.mobile_recommendation: Add per-card controls for contactless, online and overseas (NAB), a wallet health-check/re-provision button for broken tap & pay, and temporary block that keeps direct debits running (ANZ).
Card payments, tap-to-pay & digital wall.business_intel: ANZ business credit card removed from a digital wallet after a KYC block; Westpac business cards need a phone number in profile settings for SMS codes before Apple Pay works and the business Apple Pay card art is hard to read; NAB offers a Qantas Business Signature card used for equipment purchases.

Fees, surcharges & charges.title: Fee preview before payments and transfers
Fees, surcharges & charges.positives: International fees were reversed after card fraud; fees are generally low on rewards cards when conditions are met.
Fees, surcharges & charges.negatives: High overdraft fees, double charges, removal of 0% international fees, and opaque charges.
Fees, surcharges & charges.improvement: Make fees and surcharges transparent up front, reduce/avoid avoidable fees (overdraft, international, ATM) and offer fee-free options.
Fees, surcharges & charges.competitor_offer: ANZ Plus has zero account fees and ANZ Access Advantage is reported to offer a free overdraft; Westpac customers call their fee-free account 'the best'; NAB customers cite no ongoing fees on accounts. Fee transparency is a selling point for ANZ Plus.
Fees, surcharges & charges.mobile_features: NAB: $0 transfer fee when sending in a foreign currency via the app; no-monthly-fee transaction accounts promoted. ANZ: Spendi daily budget indicator (does not block spending). Guides reviewed do not show in-app fee previews.
Fees, surcharges & charges.mobile_recommendation: Show a fee preview before submitting payments/transfers and an in-app fee summary; keep a zero-fee path for overseas transfers (NAB $0 foreign-currency transfer fee).
Fees, surcharges & charges.business_intel: ANZ account blocks triggering dishonour fees on business direct debits are cited as a cost of poor KYC handling.

International & FX transfers.title: In-app travel notices and low-fee overseas transfers
International & FX transfers.positives: Cards work overseas for many; Smart Awards has offered 0% international fees (now ending).
International & FX transfers.negatives: International transaction fees (3.5%), notification for international transactions stuck off, and poor overseas service.
International & FX transfers.improvement: Offer competitive FX rates, low/zero international fees, clearer transfer tracking and a simpler overseas/student payment flow.
International & FX transfers.competitor_offer: Competitors are not seen as strong here: customers recommend Wise, Revolut, Up (zero international fees) or ING instead of ANZ/NAB/Westpac for FX; Westpac Worldwide Wallet is the main overseas offer. Opportunity to lead with competitive FX.
International & FX transfers.mobile_features: NAB: international transfers from the NAB app with $0 transfer fee in foreign currency; FX rates calculator on web. ANZ: app works overseas with roaming; tell ANZ your travel plans in the app. Westpac NZ (indicative): notify overseas travel plans and set up digital banking for overseas.
International & FX transfers.mobile_recommendation: Add in-app travel notices (ANZ, Westpac NZ), a live FX rate/fee preview and a low-fee overseas transfer path (NAB).
International & FX transfers.business_intel: Business customers lean on Wise and Revolut rather than the big banks for international payments, including while accounts were frozen.

Cash, cheques, deposits & ATMs.title: Reliable cardless cash and deposit with clear failure reasons
Cash, cheques, deposits & ATMs.positives: Cardless cash/deposit in the app and free use of bank-operated ATMs are valued.
Cash, cheques, deposits & ATMs.negatives: Cardless cash withdrawals/deposits failing, third-party ATM fees and fewer branches.
Cash, cheques, deposits & ATMs.improvement: Maintain ATM/deposit coverage, offer mobile cheque deposit and smart deposit options, and give clear hold/clearance timings.
Cash, cheques, deposits & ATMs.competitor_offer: NAB leads with mobile cheque deposit in the app (customers call it very easy, even with no branches nearby); ANZ restored Bank@Post access for essential banking; Westpac customers still describe cheque clearing taking up to 2 weeks.
Cash, cheques, deposits & ATMs.mobile_features: Guides reviewed do not cover ATM or cardless cash features. NAB: Quick Balance without login. ANZ: Quick Balance (iOS 18 removed the Today View widget).
Cash, cheques, deposits & ATMs.mobile_recommendation: Competitor guides give no lead here; focus on reliability of cardless cash/deposit and a simple 'why did this fail' message.
Cash, cheques, deposits & ATMs.business_intel: ANZ Plus Business customers ask for online cheque deposit (as NAB offers); a business cheque from ANZ was refused by Suncorp; funds visible but unavailable after a deposit slip at ANZ.

Loans, mortgages & interest rates.title: Loan details, repayments and rate review inside the app
Loans, mortgages & interest rates.positives: Loan and bonus-interest rules are explained clearly by peers; app-based loan journeys are praised.
Loans, mortgages & interest rates.negatives: Personal loans criticised (customers use brokers), app update broke mortgage payments, unknown Step Pay transactions, and rate frustration.
Loans, mortgages & interest rates.improvement: Offer more competitive and consistent rates for existing customers (not only new/refinance deals), clearer repayment/offset information and faster hardship support.
Loans, mortgages & interest rates.competitor_offer: ANZ retention teams offer cashback (about $2k) and rate cuts (around 5.3-5.9%) when customers ask or lodge a discharge form; NAB offers variable rates with DHOAS (about 5.8%) and an Equity Builder loan; Westpac customers compare their rates unfavourably with mates' and other banks' offers. Broker-lodged deals are common for all.
Loans, mortgages & interest rates.mobile_features: ANZ: view home loan rate, balance, repayment and available redraw in the app; Instalment Plan on credit cards. Westpac NZ (indicative): change loan repayments and fix/refix a home loan online. NAB: calculators and appointment booking on web.
Loans, mortgages & interest rates.mobile_recommendation: Show loan rate, balance, repayment and redraw in-app (ANZ); let customers change repayments and manage fixed-rate options in-app (Westpac NZ pattern); link rate-review requests to a Message Us thread.
Loans, mortgages & interest rates.business_intel: NAB business lending is described as demanding property collateral over cash flow (a loan rejected for not owning a home); ANZ self-employed policy is reported as ABN registered 18 months, 12 months financials, tax returns and NOA, with heavy paperwork and BAS requests; one customer refinanced to Suncorp for friendlier self-employed policy.

Investments, shares & super.title: Surface CommSec balances and trades in the app
Investments, shares & super.positives: CommSec/CommBank integration and linked accounts are appreciated by investors.
Investments, shares & super.negatives: Trading fees (e.g. $30 to sell an ETF), negative trade settlements, missing CommSec balances, and dysfunctional scanning tools.
Investments, shares & super.improvement: Improve trading/investing integration and fees, clearer super/investment reporting and smoother linkage with everyday accounts.
Investments, shares & super.competitor_offer: ANZ app has automatic round-up saving (customers say it makes saving effortless); NAB offers Equity Builder loans for investing; Westpac/NAB have no standout investing offer in the comments. Competitor feedback is limited.
Investments, shares & super.mobile_features: NAB: nabtrade linked from login menu. Westpac NZ (indicative): KiwiSaver balance, contributions, fund and rate changes in the app (NZ-specific). ANZ guide: super and investing enquiries go to 'Give us a call'.
Investments, shares & super.mobile_recommendation: Surface CommSec balances and trades inside the app and keep linkage with everyday accounts (NAB links nabtrade at login).
Investments, shares & super.business_intel: Westpac customers weigh buying shares through the Westpac app to keep personal and business banking under one roof.

Outages & service availability.title: In-app service status and outage fallback channels
Outages & service availability.positives: Few positives; maintenance windows are announced.
Outages & service availability.negatives: Weekend maintenance blocking transfers with no compensation, forced updates blocking access, and dismissive branch staff during outages.
Outages & service availability.improvement: Improve uptime and resilience, publish live service status, and provide fallback channels (SMS, web, phone) during outages.
Outages & service availability.competitor_offer: ANZ Plus, NAB and Westpac customers all report outages, with ANZ Plus users unable to reach support during downtime. No competitor stands out for uptime.
Outages & service availability.mobile_features: NAB and Westpac NZ both link a service status page from the site footer/menu; ANZ publishes a digital service status page for institutional customers. Message Us (ANZ) and call-from-app (ANZ, NAB) give alternative channels.
Outages & service availability.mobile_recommendation: Add an in-app service-status banner and a fallback channel (Message Us/call-from-app) when features are down; give maintenance notices before weekend windows.
Outages & service availability.business_intel: ANZ app cannot open multiple business profiles under one CRN (works on desktop); a Westpac cashflow chart broke after maintenance.

Login, authentication & security lock-ou.title: Stable biometrics, multi-device PIN and self-service recovery
Login, authentication & security lock-ou.positives: Fingerprint/biometric and 2FA are seen as secure by some; refresh and login suggestions show engagement.
Login, authentication & security lock-ou.negatives: Cannot log in or repeatedly locked out, mandatory in-app 2FA for desktop failing when notifications are off, and repeated log-ins.
Login, authentication & security lock-ou.improvement: Make login more reliable and less intrusive: stable biometrics, fewer forced logouts, clearer NetCode/SMS delivery, and self-service recovery after lock-outs.
Login, authentication & security lock-ou.competitor_offer: Westpac has fixed biometric sign-in and remembers the customer ID after updates but is the main target of login complaints; ANZ Plus uses ANZ Shield app codes in place of SMS; NAB customers describe simple sign-in and quick balance. Customers ask for a logout button available from every screen (ANZ) and session persistence (Westpac).
Login, authentication & security lock-ou.mobile_features: ANZ: one 4-digit PIN across up to 5 devices; change PIN in-app or online; auto log-out after inactivity; Voice ID, fingerprint and face scan. NAB: password, 4-digit passcode, fingerprint or Face ID. Westpac NZ (indicative): Face ID/fingerprint/PIN guide, reset PIN or password in-app, manage app devices.
Login, authentication & security lock-ou.mobile_recommendation: Allow one PIN across devices and robust biometric fallback (ANZ); self-service reset in-app (Westpac NZ); do not force repeated logins or app-only 2FA for desktop when notifications are off.
Login, authentication & security lock-ou.business_recommendation: BUSINESS: NAB Connect mobile token; customers report trouble using business and personal profiles in one app. Suggest one login that switches between personal and business profiles.
Login, authentication & security lock-ou.business_intel: Westpac business users report lock-outs, password rejection, biometric errors, a 1-hour call wait and no 2FA on online banking login; ANZ Voice ID is called outdated and physical security keys are not accepted as 2FA; NAB locks users out despite a verified device and has fingerprint problems; NAB business and personal login in one app is hard.

Security, privacy & device compatibility.title: Clear device-support policy and plain-language data use
Security, privacy & device compatibility.positives: Customers value strong security and the bank's fraud protections.
Security, privacy & device compatibility.negatives: Invasive data collection (installed apps, keystrokes, swipes), forced updates/T&Cs, and device bugs (e.g. blank screen on Samsung S25).
Security, privacy & device compatibility.improvement: Broaden device/OS compatibility (older, rooted, custom-ROM or VPN use cases), give clear error messages, and be transparent on data/privacy use.
Security, privacy & device compatibility.strength: Secure app that works across devices
Security, privacy & device compatibility.competitor_offer: NAB customers praise a secure app but are the most vocal about device compatibility (older Android/Samsung devices, battery drain) and VPN/rooted-device blocking; Westpac Android users report forced logouts; ANZ Plus is praised as secure.
Security, privacy & device compatibility.mobile_features: ANZ: states minimum OS (iOS 15 / Android 8) and recommends auto-updates, offers Internet Banking as the fallback for unsupported devices; explains behavioural data collection openly. Westpac NZ (indicative): guidance for phones/tablets that do not support the app and for data collected while using the app. NAB: states minimum platform requirements.
Security, privacy & device compatibility.mobile_recommendation: Publish a clear device-support policy and a fallback web login for unsupported devices (ANZ); explain data collection in plain language and offer opt-down where possible.
Security, privacy & device compatibility.business_intel: NAB app update dropped support for a work phone used for a business account.

App crashes, bugs & performance.title: Stabilise releases: staged roll-outs and update grace period
App crashes, bugs & performance.positives: Many describe the app as effortless, quick and reliable.
App crashes, bugs & performance.negatives: Tap & pay and QR cardless failures, crashes in rewards/cards areas, 'Contact us' not working, and unreliable access to funds.
App crashes, bugs & performance.improvement: Fix crashes, slow loading and update regressions; strengthen release testing, staged roll-outs and crash monitoring, and communicate known issues.
App crashes, bugs & performance.competitor_offer: NAB customers describe a fast, reliable app for many users, with complaints of slowdown after updates; Westpac has the highest volume of crash/lag complaints; ANZ comments focus on update loops and reinstall failures. Stability is a differentiator for NAB.
App crashes, bugs & performance.mobile_features: Westpac NZ (indicative): 'Why are you asking me to update the app?', how to update and turn on auto-updates. NAB: how-to guide to update the app. ANZ: update guide and note that Android/iOS feature differences are being closed over time.
App crashes, bugs & performance.mobile_recommendation: Explain why updates are required and allow a grace period; offer auto-update guidance (Westpac NZ); use staged roll-outs so forced updates do not block access.
App crashes, bugs & performance.business_intel: Business app performance complaints on all three: ANZ slow/laggy on new iPhones; NAB crashes and battery drain; Westpac Android lag, slow switching between personal and business accounts and profile switching that loses functions.

UI / UX, design & app features.title: Budgeting, insights and personalisation upgrades
UI / UX, design & app features.positives: App called user-friendly and brilliant; new spending categories and budget features are liked.
UI / UX, design & app features.negatives: Forced updates blocking access, removed features (average monthly spend line, missing budget categories), and battery drain.
UI / UX, design & app features.improvement: Prioritise requested features (dark mode, customisable home, notifications, budgeting/insights, receipts) and keep navigation simple; test big redesigns with customers before release.
UI / UX, design & app features.competitor_offer: NAB app is repeatedly described as intuitive, easy to navigate and packed with services (in-app changes to limits, travel notices, chat), though users want dark mode; ANZ Plus is praised as modern with account aggregation and savings round-ups; Westpac's refreshed app is liked for easy recurring payments.
UI / UX, design & app features.mobile_features: NAB: Cash Prediction (budgeting), Saving Spaces (savings goals), Spending tool, tap-to-identify purchase, Quick Balance. ANZ: Spendi daily budget indicator, cleaner transaction descriptions, Instalment Plan, ongoing payments view. Westpac NZ (indicative): change account image and reorder accounts, bigger text, quick accounts.
UI / UX, design & app features.mobile_recommendation: Prioritise budgeting/insights (NAB Cash Prediction, Saving Spaces; ANZ Spendi), dark mode/text size/account reorder personalisation (Westpac NZ), and keep removed insights features available.
UI / UX, design & app features.business_recommendation: BUSINESS: Westpac business owners cite a laggy app and lost cash-flow category editing; ANZ spreads personal/business across apps. Suggest keeping cash-flow tools with editable categories in the business view.
UI / UX, design & app features.business_intel: ANZ Plus is praised as a #1 app for personal and business use with personalised transaction tags, but ANZ nags users to update their profile; NAB is called reliable for day-to-day and business use; Westpac's cash-flow/insights feature lost category editing and business owners call the app laggy (web is faster).

Customer service & support.title: In-app messaging, call-from-app and specialist booking
Customer service & support.positives: Staff praised for quick, efficient issue resolution; individual bankers get named thanks.
Customer service & support.negatives: 1-3 hour call waits, outsourced/hard-to-understand support, unhelpful Ceba chatbot, and no one to speak to in store.
Customer service & support.improvement: Cut wait times, offer call-back and in-app chat/messaging with human escalation, empower first-contact resolution and improve staff empathy/consistency.
Customer service & support.competitor_offer: NAB and Westpac customers praise 24/7 customer care and efficient in-app chat; ANZ has a retention team, a card disputes team and messaging channel but long call-wait complaints and a fragmented ANZ vs ANZ Plus experience. Branch staff at all three get frequent individual praise.
Customer service & support.mobile_features: ANZ: Message Us (secure in-app messaging for savings, transaction, credit card, home loan), call from the app, book a specialist appointment from Support, 24/7 phone. NAB: call from the NAB app for personal or business, Customer Support Tool for guided self-service. Westpac NZ (indicative): how-to guides for most tasks.
Customer service & support.mobile_recommendation: Add secure in-app messaging with human escalation and call-from-app with pre-authentication (ANZ, NAB), plus in-app specialist booking.
Customer service & support.business_recommendation: BUSINESS: ANZ and NAB offer call-from-app with business support routes. Suggest a business-specific Message Us queue with service-level targets.
Customer service & support.business_intel: Business customers cite slow service everywhere: an ANZ business-banking specialist replying about once a day; NAB in-app messaging with 44-hour waits and days-long waits for bankers; Westpac 1-hour call waits when locked out.

Notifications & alerts.title: Reliable real-time alerts with preferences and failure notices
Notifications & alerts.positives: Configurable notifications are liked and considered a strong feature.
Notifications & alerts.negatives: No alert on a large fraudulent spend, forced spending notifications, duplicate or missing notifications, and lost notification sound.
Notifications & alerts.improvement: Provide reliable, configurable real-time notifications (money in/out, card expiry, security alerts) with fewer delays and duplicates.
Notifications & alerts.competitor_offer: ANZ sends payment notifications in real time (customers say it doubles as a security safeguard) but some users request incoming-money alerts like CBA; Westpac customers like notification delivery and balance checks. NAB has little feedback in this area.
Notifications & alerts.mobile_features: Westpac NZ (indicative): manage notifications, give feedback on a notification, see which notifications you have, dismiss one. ANZ: push notifications for business payments end on 16 September 2026 (Message Us notifications and savings goals remain); a failed future payment sends no alert. Guides reviewed show no competitor lead on real-time payment alerts.
Notifications & alerts.mobile_recommendation: Keep real-time payment push for personal and business accounts (ANZ is withdrawing business push from 16 Sep 2026), add notification preferences and a 'give feedback on this notification' control (Westpac NZ), and alert on failed scheduled payments.
Notifications & alerts.business_recommendation: BUSINESS: ANZ stops push notifications for incoming/outgoing business payments from 16 Sep 2026; Westpac business customers also report none. Real-time business payment alerts are a clear differentiator for CBA to keep and promote.
Notifications & alerts.business_intel: Real gap across competitors: Westpac business accounts reportedly offer no push, email or SMS instant notifications on deposits/payments; ANZ business notifications are described as stopped or hours late (while one user notes business customers get push alerts before consumers). CBA's instant notifications are a differentiator. Westpac business term-deposit notices send customers to check electronic mail with no clear change.

Branch closures & in-person access.title: Accessibility guide and in-app appointment booking
Branch closures & in-person access.positives: Customers keep CBA for branch access; in-branch help resolves some issues.
Branch closures & in-person access.negatives: Branch closures, being told to withdraw in branch or go online, and staff not trained for personal loans.
Branch closures & in-person access.improvement: Maintain in-person and assisted channels for those who need them (regional, elderly, vision-impaired) and improve accessibility features in the app.
Branch closures & in-person access.competitor_offer: Westpac/St George customers praise local branch staff but note short staffing and fewer branches; ANZ customers cite longer branch waits and cashless moves; Westpac app is called good for vision-impaired users. In-person service remains a mixed picture for competitors.
Branch closures & in-person access.mobile_features: ANZ: publishes an Easy Read guide to the app for accessibility and lets customers book branch/specialist appointments in-app. NAB: dedicated mobile app accessibility page. Westpac NZ (indicative): how to make text bigger on your phone.
Branch closures & in-person access.mobile_recommendation: Publish an Easy Read/accessibility guide and accessibility features page for the app (ANZ, NAB), and add in-app appointment booking for branch or phone support.
Branch closures & in-person access.business_intel: NAB business customers face ID-question locks after card theft; ANZ branches can handle large (>$25k) SMSF transfers over the counter.

Brand, pricing, policy & corporate condu.title: In-app transparency on data use, fees and policy changes
Brand, pricing, policy & corporate condu.positives: Few positives; some customers still trust the CBA brand over rivals.
Brand, pricing, policy & corporate condu.negatives: Record profits, job losses/outsourcing blamed on AI, executive criticism and perceived greed.
Brand, pricing, policy & corporate condu.improvement: Rebuild trust through visible customer-first decisions: fair pricing, responsible staffing/offshoring choices, transparent communication and ethical conduct.
Brand, pricing, policy & corporate condu.competitor_offer: Competitor comments mention the Big Four's profits and the oligopoly (ANZ, NAB, Westpac equally); NAB is cited for lending flexibility (undersecured business lending) and Westpac for fines/management history. No strong brand offer found.
Brand, pricing, policy & corporate condu.mobile_features: Not a mobile-app feature area. ANZ's open explanation of why behavioural data is collected is the closest app-level trust measure.
Brand, pricing, policy & corporate condu.mobile_recommendation: Use in-app transparency (data use, fees, policy changes) to rebuild trust.

Overall app experience (general praise /.title: Reduce top detractors: forced updates and login friction
Overall app experience (general praise /.positives: Most positive comments call the app best-in-class, easy to use and reliable, with frequent thanks to helpful staff.
Overall app experience (general praise /.negatives: Forced updates, balances not up to date, removed portfolio view, no way to contact a human, and tap & pay crashes.
Overall app experience (general praise /.improvement: Address recurring pain points behind low ratings (reliability, updates, login, support) and close the loop with developer replies to reviews.
Overall app experience (general praise /.competitor_offer: Competitor app ratings are polarised: NAB is widely described as a 'best banking app' with high security and efficient chat, ANZ Plus as modern and easy, Westpac as secure with dynamic CVC but more complaints about glitches.
Overall app experience (general praise /.mobile_features: Competitor apps combine: in-app support (ANZ Message Us, NAB call-from-app), budgeting (NAB Cash Prediction/Saving Spaces, ANZ Spendi), clearer merchant info (ANZ, NAB), and one PIN across devices (ANZ).
Overall app experience (general praise /.mobile_recommendation: Pair a stable core with in-app support, clearer merchant details, budgeting and multi-device convenience; track forced-update and login friction as top detractors.
Overall app experience (general praise /.business_intel: Westpac cashflow tools get specific feedback (wanting custom month start dates, a faulty chart); NAB users ask about transaction timestamps; ANZ business app is called complicated by some and 'a total joke' by others, though NAB loyalty is also expressed.
